tei:div.tei:p: hūm̐/ phur pa'i srung ma dam tshig can// g.yung drung lcags rtse gnyan po la// shan pa ling pa dregs pa'i tshogs// 'dir gshegs phud kyis mchod pa bzhes// sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs// ma lus rtsad nas gcod pa dang*// gang bcol phrin las rnam pa bzhi// thogs med myur du 'grub par mdzod//

bla ma 'dre dga' nor li'i ngor/ kaḥthog mkhan zur las 'brel rtsal gyis bris pa dge'o// 'um̐ḥ hūm̐ bh+yo: sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po srung ba dang : gsang sngags bka' yi srung ma mthu mo che: rnal 'byor sgrub pa po yi dgra bla mo: sha za dhā ki ma mo kha mo che: skad cig nyid la gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: gnod byed dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i gdan la bzhugs: khyod sngon slob dpon pad+ma thod phreng gis: dpal gyi bsam yas mchims phu'i ge gong du: rtsa gsum lha yi dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas: yang zab bka' yi chos srung gnyer byang gtad: nam zhig las ldan bstan pa spel ba'i tshe: bshad sgrub bstan pa mtha' ru rgyas byed cing ཿ dam ldan rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyong dgos pa'iḥ bka' bsgo dam tshig rdo rje spyi bor bzhag: ji ltar rgyal ba'i bka' las ma 'da' bar: dngos 'byor yid sprul mthun rdzas dpag med pa: sman rag gtor ma'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi: sngon las 'phral rkyen bar chad zhi ba dang : tshe dpal longs spyod mnga' thang rgyas pa dang : phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub par mdzod: mi dang mi min bar chad zhi bar mdzod: bshad sgrub bstan pa dus 'dir rgyas par mdzod: dbang sdud lha mi dbang du 'du bar mdzod: ma hā rak+ta su tā ko: su ro ki: ba su ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ lan gsum/ bh+yo sha za dhā ki ma mo tsit+ta hring hring dzaḥ zhes bzla'o/ kha thaṃ/
